cases.explain: The verb 'смотреть' (to look) with the preposition 'на' takes the accusative case
The verb 'сделать' (to make) takes the accusative case
The verb 'перейти' (to cross) takes the accusative case for the object crossed
The preposition 'по' (along, on) when indicating location requires the dative case

cases.translation: does not take his eyes from the people
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (from) requires the genitive case

cases.translation: so that rebels against Him do not rise up
cases.explain: Nominative case for the subject of the verb 'восстали' (rose up)
The verb 'воздать' (to render, to give) takes the accusative case
The preposition 'сквозь' (through) requires the accusative case

reading.ru: Придите, смотрите на Божьи дела, как устрашающие его дела для сынов человеческих
reading.question: What are people invited to do?
options: To come and look at God's awesome deeds
reading.correct: To come and look at God's awesome deeds
reading.explain: The text says 'Придите, смотрите на Божьи дела' (Come, look at God's deeds)

reading.ru: Он сохранил нам жизнь и не дал нашим ногам споткнуться
reading.question: What has God done for His people?
options: Preserved their lives and kept their feet from slipping
reading.correct: Preserved their lives and kept their feet from slipping
reading.explain: The text says 'сохранил нам жизнь и не дал нашим ногам споткнуться' (preserved our lives and did not let our feet slip)

reading.ru: Боже, Ты испытал нас, очистил, как серебро
reading.question: What does the psalmist say God has done to His people?
options: Tested them and purified them like silver
reading.correct: Tested them and purified them like silver
reading.explain: The text says 'Ты испытал нас, очистил, как серебро' (You tested us, purified us like silver)

reading.ru: Мы прошли сквозь огонь и воду, но ты нас вывел к месту изобилия
reading.question: What happened after the people passed through trials?
options: God brought them out to a place of abundance
They were abandoned by the Lord
reading.correct: God brought them out to a place of abundance
reading.explain: The text says 'ты нас вывел к месту изобилия' (you brought us out to a place of abundance)

reading.ru: Я приду в твой храм со всесожжениями и исполню свои обеты тебе
reading.question: What will the speaker do at God's temple?
options: Bring sacrifices and fulfill his vows
reading.correct: Bring sacrifices and fulfill his vows
reading.explain: The text says 'приду в твой храм со всесожжениями и исполню свои обеты' (I will come to Your temple with sacrifices and fulfill my vows)

reading.ru: Благословен будь Бог, не отвергший мою молитву и милости меня не лишивший
reading.question: How does the psalm conclude regarding God's response?
options: God is blessed for not rejecting prayer and withholding mercy
reading.correct: God is blessed for not rejecting prayer and withholding mercy
reading.explain: The text says God is 'не отвергший мою молитву и милости меня не лишивший' (not rejected my prayer and not withheld mercy)
